plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: KH Royals uses your location when you announce car line pickup and, if you turn on automatic check-in, to notice when you arrive at school. Teachers and staff who agree also send it when they answer a critical alert, so the office can find them; only alert senders see that, and it's erased after the alert. Your location is never tracked.
